spec.name: sprint40_taker_imbalance_etf_v1
spec.hypothesis: 5-minute taker buy/sell volume imbalance on liquid index ETFs predicts same-direction price drift over the following 15 minutes (order-flow momentum), net of T1 costs.
spec.power_argument: Single-symbol SPY cannot reach n>=300 in the remaining sprint window. Pooling 4 liquid, low-cross-correlation index ETFs (SPY, QQQ, IWM, DIA) at entry_per_day_cap=6 each = 24 entries/day x ~13 remaining pre-registered trading days = ~312 trades, clearing the 300 floor. Assumed per-trade 15-min return stdev ~15bps (historical ETF intraday vol) gives SE = 15/sqrt(312) ~ 0.85bps; a t=2 threshold implies min detectable edge ~1.7bps net. T1 round-trip cost (~1-2bps) leaves this edge economically meaningful if found, and the null (0bps) is falsifiable — unlike sprint37-39, which returned n=0 and never actually tested a null.
